x-redis-stream.description: Redis Streams XADD record. The data field is a JSON string containing the event. This extension documents Redis Streams because standard Pub/Sub bindings do not.

kind.description: Extensible event kind; canonical and observed sets are listed in x-mind-mem.

payload.description: Scrubbed scalar/id/hash metadata; block prose is dropped before publishing.

info.description: Opt-in outbound Redis Streams notification contract. The publisher appends a JSON event to one stream; failures are swallowed.
info.title: mind-mem outbound events

publishMindMemEvent.description: Best-effort outbound append from the configured publisher. No consumer group, retry, acknowledgement, ordering, or at-least-once guarantee is part of this contract.

x-mind-mem.delivery: best-effort outbound append; publish failures are swallowed and not retried
x-mind-mem.event_kind_policy: extensible string; canonical names are advisory taxonomy
x-mind-mem.payload_policy: scrub_payload permits bounded ids, hashes, enums, numbers and booleans; prose is dropped
